claims.quote: YORVIPATH is indicated for the treatment of hypoparathyroidism in adults.

claims.text: not studied for acute post-surgical hypoparathyroidism
claims.quote: YORVIPATH was not studied for acute post-surgical hypoparathyroidism.
claims.locator: 1 Indications and Usage: Limitations of Use

claims.text: Start 18 mcg once daily; titrate in 3 mcg steps to keep Ca normal without active vitamin D or therapeutic Ca doses
claims.quote: The recommended starting dosage is 18 mcg once daily and is titrated in 3 mcg increments or decrements with the goal of maintaining serum calcium within the normal range without the need for active vitamin D (e.g., calcitriol) or therapeutic calcium doses
The maximum recommended dosage is 30 mcg subcutaneously once daily.

claims.text: Check serum Ca 7 to 10 days after the first dose and after any dose change
claims.quote: Measure serum calcium 7 to 10 days after the first YORVIPATH dose and after any dose change in YORVIPATH, active vitamin D, or calcium supplements
